comments.author: @TheCivilizedMind
comments.text: Taiwan produces some of the world's most advanced chips, yet many young people still struggle with housing costs and starting a family. Do you think a country's technological success should be measured by how much it improves everyday life? Why or why not?

replies.author: @icracked.1
replies.text: That's a problem mostly in metropolitan area like New Taipei City and surrounding cities where housing cost is ridiculously expensive. In smaller cities, housing and cost of living are more affordable.
